notice: Approximate total shared-cM ranges used only to check whether an observed match amount is plausible for the relationship implied by recorded parent links. Not a likelihood, identification or genetic test.

sources.pedsim: Kinfold research pipeline: 99% interval (0.5th-99.5th percentile) of positive-sharing pairs in Ped-sim full-cousin simulations (Williams 2025, Zenodo 17489849, CC BY 4.0; ss_intf model, 100,000 pairs per class). Simulated totals, no detection threshold.
sources.shared_cm_project: Approximate ranges from the Shared cM Project v4 (Blaine Bettinger, 2020, CC BY 4.0). Verify against the current published tool before relying on exact bounds.
